title: Audit Me If You Can: Query-Efficient Active Fairness Auditing of Black-Box LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology of query-efficient fairness auditing for black-box models. While it evaluates bias across demographic groups including religion (using the CivilComments dataset), this is treated as a standard demographic slice for a machine learning auditing tool rather than a dedicated evaluation or benchmarking of religious traditions, theology, or ethical systems.
